summary:
Rising climate volatility, shifting rainfall patterns, and rapid topsoil depletion threaten global agricultural security. TerraRotate is an open-source, climate-smart decision engine that generates resilient, site-specific crop rotation sequences for any farm on Earth.

By fusing real-time NASA Earth Observations (NASA POWER agroclimatology, GPM precipitation, and SMAP surface soil moisture) with ISRIC SoilGrids physical and biochemical profiles (pH, soil organic carbon, sand/clay composition), TerraRotate assesses true localized ecological carrying capacity. These environmental features are processed through a 98.2% accurate FastAI Deep Learning Tabular Classifier trained on empirical agronomic trials, coupled with a biophysical stress-gating architecture.

Rather than recommending high-risk monocultures, TerraRotate algorithmically constructs three adaptive rotational pathways: a baseline risk assessment, a soil armor and biological nitrogen-fixation cycle, and a drought-resilient deep-taproot system. TerraRotate bridges space-borne Earth observation with practical, regenerative farm management to preserve subsoil moisture and protect farmer livelihoods.
details:
What Does It Do & How Does It Work? TerraRotate is a climate-adaptive agronomic advisory system. A farmer or agricultural extension officer inputs any regional coordinate or farm location worldwide. In real time, the platform executes a multi-stream data ingestion and deep learning pipeline: 1. Space-Borne Earth Observation Ingestion: Queries the NASA POWER Agroclimatology API to extract daily temperature regimes (T2M), surface relative humidity (RH2M), precipitation dynamics (PRECTOTCORR derived from GPM/IMERG), and topsoil moisture saturation (GWETTOP derived from NASA SMAP). 2. Pedological Physics Extraction: Queries the ISRIC SoilGrids REST API to extract physical soil texture (clay and sand fractions), active soil organic carbon (SOC), and soil pH at root-zone depths (0-5 cm). 3. Deep Learning Inference: Environmental and pedological features are fed into a production FastAI Tabular Neural Network (achieving 98.2% validation accuracy on empirical agricultural trial records) to classify crop viability probabilities across 22 major crop species. 4. Biophysical Stress Gating & Rotation Synthesis: Raw neural network probabilities are cross-validated against strict biophysical rainfall survival thresholds (eliminating ecologically impossible recommendations such as water-intensive crops in arid zones) and user resilience priorities. The engine then algorithmically builds three distinct multi-season crop rotation pathways: - Strategy 1: Conventional Monoculture Baseline: Quantifies the erosion and climate-risk exposure of standard continuous cash cropping. - Strategy 2: Biological Nitrogen Fixation & Soil Armor: Synthesizes cash crops with leguminous nitrogen-fixers (e.g., chickpea, lentil, vetch) to restore soil organic carbon and reduce synthetic fertilizer dependency. - Strategy 3: Climate-Resilient Taproot System: Deploys deep-root pulse varieties (e.g., mothbeans, pigeonpeas) capable of scavenging subsoil moisture during NASA SMAP-detected drought periods while breaking pest cycles. Intended Benefits & Impact - Mitigating Climate Shocks: Alerts producers to historical drought windows and topsoil moisture deficits before sowing. - Soil Conservation: Eliminates bare fallow cycles by prescribing green manure and cover crops that reduce soil erosion and nitrogen runoff. - Economic Decoupling: Replaces synthetic fertilizer inputs with biological nitrogen fixation, lowering farm input costs while preserving groundwaters. Tools, Languages, Hardware & Software - Programming Languages: Python 3.12 - Deep Learning Framework: FastAI / PyTorch (Tabular Deep Neural Network with Normalize transforms and One-Cycle learning policy) - APIs & Web Services: NASA POWER Agroclimatology REST API, ISRIC SoilGrids REST API v2.0, OpenStreetMap Nominatim Geocoding API - Data Engineering: Pandas, NumPy - Frontend & Visualization: Streamlit Cloud, Plotly Express & Graph Objects Factors Considered & Creativity Standard agricultural tools rely on static regional tables or black-box advice. TerraRotate dynamically couples live satellite telemetry with soil physics and deep learning. We deliberately architected biophysical gating constraints to ensure recommendations honor real hydrological boundaries (preventing AI hallucinations in extreme desert or frost environments) while providing transparent agronomic reasoning for every suggested rotation.
